ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a benzene ring on the left, fused on the right with a heteroatom-containing cyclic structure; above, near the fusion site, there is an O marked with positive charge and connected to H, and beside it there is also an R2 substituent; below, inside the ring, there is N-H, and on the lower right side an R1 substituent is connected. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the question requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: Only count bonds not related to hydrogen. There are a total of 6 C-C bonds around the benzene ring, among which the fused edge shared with the right ring is counted only once. The right heterocycle has another 4 non-hydrogen bonds besides the edge shared with the benzene ring. There are a total of 3 non-hydrogen bonds externally connected to O, R2, and R1. Exclude the O-H and N-H bonds. Therefore the total number is 6 + 4 + 3 = 13.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the visible structure: a benzene ring is fused on the right to a heterocyclic ring, with an O-H/O+ feature near the upper fusion area, an N-H in the lower ring, and R2 and R1 substituents. Then count bonds by direct scan: count 6 C-C bonds around the benzene ring, including the fused vertical edge only once; count the 4 additional non-H bonds forming the right-side ring outside the benzene edge; count the 3 exocyclic non-H bonds to O, R2, and R1. Exclude the O-H and N-H bonds and disregard arrows. Sum 6 + 4 + 3 = 13.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中显示一个左侧苯环，右侧与一个含杂原子的环状结构稠合；上方靠近稠合处有带正电标记的 O，并与 H 相连，旁边还有 R2 取代基；下方环内有 N-H，右下侧连有 R1 取代基。图中还有弯箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：只计算非氢相关的键。苯环周围共有 6 条 C-C 键，其中与右侧环共用的稠合边只计一次。右侧杂环在苯环共用边之外还有 4 条非氢键。外接到 O、R2、R1 的非氢键共有 3 条。排除 O-H 和 N-H 键。因此总数为 6 + 4 + 3 = 13。

method.method_draft: First describe the visual topology: the left part is a benzene six-ring; the right part is a fused heterocyclic ring sharing one edge with the benzene; outside the ring framework are bonds to O, R2, and R1, while O-H and N-H are explicit hydrogen bonds.
